title: Mi historia: quién soy
summary: Week-1 capstone: sounds, greetings, ser/estar/tener — then your first self-intro layer

blocks.title: Repaso: semana 1
blocks.body: In one week you've met the **five vowels** and the **acento**, the Castilian **'th' (distinción)** and the **jota**, greetings with **vale/venga**, the verbs **ser / estar / tener**, negation with **no**, and gender with **el/la, un/una**. That's the whole foundation. Vamos a juntarlo todo.
blocks.callout: This is the end of week 1. Ponte una caña mental — has hecho mucho, ¿eh?

lines.nl: Soy de Canadá y estoy en Madrid.
lines.en: I'm from Canada and I'm in Madrid.

blocks.prompt: Which verb goes with location — 'I'm in Madrid'?
blocks.explain: Location = **estar**: *estoy en Madrid*. Origin would be *soy de Madrid* (ser).
*Aprendo español.* (In Spain you'll also hear *castellano* for the language.)

blocks.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

pairs.left: ser → who you are, where you're from
pairs.right: estar → how you feel, where you are now
pairs.note: *Soy de Toronto* (identity) vs *estoy cansado* (state). The pack's biggest idea — you'll master it in week 3.

blocks.scene: Lucía introduces you to Rafa at the bar — put the whole week together

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.nl: Rafa, este es Alex. Está aprendiendo español.
lines.en: Rafa, this is Alex. He's learning Spanish.

lines.speaker: Rafa
lines.en: Oh nice! Where are you from?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Soy de Toronto, pero ahora estoy en Madrid.
lines.en: I'm from Toronto, but now I'm in Madrid.
lines.spotlight: ser de (origin) + estar en (location) in one line.

lines.speaker: Rafa
lines.en: Great! Are you hungry? There are tapas.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Un poco. Y sed. ¡Una caña, por favor!
lines.en: A little. And thirsty. A beer, please!

blocks.title: Mi historia — capa 1
blocks.prompt: Build your first self-introduction: your name, where you're from, and that you're learning Spanish.
blocks.sample: Me llamo Alex, soy de Toronto y estoy en Madrid, y aprendo español.

blocks.prompt: ¡Mi historia, semana 1! Write your self-introduction: your name, where you're from, where you are now, and that you're learning Spanish. Every week you'll add a new layer to this. ¡Enhorabuena por la primera semana!
